words.enDefinition: the order in which a program runs statements and moves between paths

examples.en: The diagram traced control flow from the first condition to the message printed for each grade.
examples.zh: 这张图跟踪了从第一个条件到按分数等级输出提示的「控制流」。

examples.en: We compared control flow before and after moving the input check inside the loop.
examples.zh: 我们比较了把输入检查移入循环前后的「控制流」。

words.enDefinition: a group of statements treated as a unit by a programming language

examples.en: The statement block after the condition runs only when a seat remains available in the example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，只有还有空位时才会运行条件后面的「语句块」。

examples.en: She put both updates in the same statement block to run them after a successful lookup.
examples.zh: 她把两个更新放进同一「语句块」，让它们在成功查到结果后执行。

collocations: enclose a statement block in braces

words.enDefinition: in Python, a statement made up of one or more clauses that can contain other statements

examples.en: Our tutor identified the loop as a compound statement consisting of a header and an indented body.
examples.zh: 导师指出，这个循环是一条「复合语句」，由头部和缩进的循环体组成。

examples.en: In Python, the entire conditional is one compound statement even when it has three separate clauses.
examples.zh: 在 Python 中，就算分成三个子句，整个条件结构也是一条「复合语句」。

collocations: the header of a compound statement

words.enDefinition: in Python, a statement expressed within a single logical line without a nested statement suite

examples.en: The Python exercise asked us to replace the simple statement assigning a total with a function call.
examples.zh: Python 练习要求我们把给总数赋值的「简单语句」改为函数调用。

examples.en: The tutor showed a simple statement that used two physical lines inside a parenthesised calculation.
examples.zh: 导师展示了一条「简单语句」，其括号内的计算跨两行书写。

words.enDefinition: a statement directing which code runs according to the outcome of a condition or selection

examples.en: Our conditional statement printed a different message when no seats remained for the evening class.
examples.zh: 晚课没有空位时，我们的「条件语句」会打印另一条消息。

examples.en: We moved the file update into a conditional statement so it ran only after approval.
examples.zh: 我们把文件更新移到「条件语句」里，让它只在获得批准后进行。

words.enDefinition: one of the paths in a program when a condition determines which code runs

examples.en: The second conditional branch handled the case where the booking existed but its room was unavailable.
examples.zh: 第二个「条件分支」处理已有预订但对应房间不可用的情况。

examples.en: The test exercised a conditional branch that the class had missed during its first demonstration.
examples.zh: 这个测试执行了课堂首次演示时遗漏的一个「条件分支」。

words.enDefinition: an expression whose result determines whether execution follows a particular path

examples.en: We rewrote the branch condition to check room capacity before the program offered any available times.
examples.zh: 我们重写了「分支条件」，让程序提供可用时段前先检查房间容量。

examples.en: The branch condition became true after the total number of bookings reached the specified limit.
examples.zh: 预订总数达到设定的上限后，「分支条件」成立。

words.enDefinition: a statement that tests one or more conditions to decide which associated block, if any, to run

examples.en: An if statement checked whether the temperature reading fell outside the range used in our demonstration.
examples.zh: 一条「if 条件语句」检查温度读数是否落在演示所用范围以外。

examples.en: Our if statement skipped the average calculation when there were no recorded scores in the list.
examples.zh: 在列表没有分数记录时，我们的「if 条件语句」跳过了平均值计算。

collocations: the condition in an if statement

words.enDefinition: the initial clause of an if statement containing the first condition and its associated code

examples.en: The if clause printed a warning when the returned item was overdue by more than seven days.
examples.zh: 归还的物品逾期超过七天时，「if 子句」会打印一条提醒。

examples.en: We changed the if clause to distinguish a missing temperature value from a valid reading of zero.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「if 子句」，以区分温度缺失和数值为零的有效读数。

collocations: add code to the if clause
test the condition in an if clause

words.enDefinition: an optional alternative clause taken when the preceding conditions do not succeed, in a conditional statement

examples.en: The else clause displayed a neutral icon whenever no matching colour had been set for the category.
examples.zh: 没有为类别设置匹配颜色时，「else 子句」会显示一个中性的图标。

examples.en: We moved that prompt into the else clause after confirming it belonged to the other outcome.
examples.zh: 确认该提示属于另一种结果后，我们把它移到了「else 子句」。

words.enDefinition: a Python clause testing another condition when earlier branches of the same if statement were skipped

examples.en: The first elif clause checked whether the recorded score qualified for the second award level.
examples.zh: 第一个「elif 子句」检查记录分数是否达到了第二档奖项的要求。

examples.en: We added an elif clause for entries created this month but updated before the review date.
examples.zh: 我们为本月创建且在审查日期前更新的条目加了一个「elif 子句」。

words.enDefinition: a sequence of connected conditional branches tested in order until one applies

examples.en: The else-if chain checked booking sizes from the largest group to the smallest group first.
examples.zh: 这条「多路条件判断链」先检查人数最多的预订，再依次判断规模较小的团体。

examples.en: We shortened the else-if chain by removing a branch that could never match any valid value.
examples.zh: 我们删掉一个无法匹配任何有效值的分支，缩短了「多路条件判断链」。

collocations: reorder branches in an else-if chain

words.enDefinition: a conditional statement placed within one of the branches of another conditional statement

examples.en: The nested conditional checked the discount only after the program had confirmed the customer's membership.
examples.zh: 程序确认顾客的会员资格之后，「嵌套条件语句」才会检查折扣。

examples.en: We drew a diagram of the nested conditional to see which messages could appear together.
examples.zh: 我们画了「嵌套条件语句」的流程图，查看哪些消息可能一起出现。

words.enDefinition: an early check that handles an exceptional or trivial input before the main logic proceeds

examples.en: A guard clause returned an empty result when the caller supplied a list with no entries.
examples.zh: 调用者传入空列表时，「卫语句」直接返回空结果。

examples.en: We put the guard clause above the calculation that needed at least one measured value.
examples.zh: 我们把「卫语句」放在至少需要一个测量值的计算之前。

words.enDefinition: a statement that selects code to execute from several cases based on a value or pattern

examples.en: The switch statement selected a label based on the category code stored in each product record.
examples.zh: 「switch 多路选择语句」按每条产品记录所存的类别代码来选取标签。

examples.en: We rewrote the switch statement after two groups of products needed to display the same icon.
examples.zh: 两组产品需要显示同一个图标后，我们重写了「switch 多路选择语句」。

collocations: add a case to a switch statement

words.enDefinition: a label identifying a value or pattern that selects a branch in a selection statement

examples.en: The JavaScript example used a case label for each supported unit of measurement in the converter.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例为换算器支持的每种计量单位设置了一个「分支标签」。

examples.en: We were missing a case label for the code representing the building's study rooms.
examples.zh: 我们漏写了楼内自习室对应代码的「分支标签」。

words.enDefinition: a branch selected by default when none of the explicitly tested cases matches

examples.en: The default case returned a generic category name when none of the recognised codes matched.
examples.zh: 没有已识别代码匹配时，「默认分支」返回了一个通用的类别名称。

examples.en: We included a default case so the exercise still displayed a label for other ticket types.
examples.zh: 我们加了一个「默认分支」，使练习程序也能给其他票种显示标签。

collocations: fall back to the default case

words.enDefinition: execution that continues into a following case instead of leaving a switch after the current case

examples.en: The JavaScript quiz illustrated case fall-through by printing two messages after a single case matched.
examples.zh: JavaScript 小测在匹配一个分支后打印了两条消息，以说明「分支贯穿」。

examples.en: We documented the intentional case fall-through where several labels shared the same reporting code.
examples.zh: 有几个标签共用同一段输出代码，我们注明这里的「分支贯穿」是有意安排的。

words.enDefinition: in Python, checking a value against a described structure and optionally binding its components to names

examples.en: The Python example used pattern matching to unpack a coordinate only when it had two elements.
examples.zh: 这个 Python 示例用「模式匹配」，只在坐标包含两个元素时才解包。

examples.en: We used pattern matching to select different code for rectangles and circles in the drawing exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在绘图练习里用「模式匹配」为矩形与圆形选择不同代码。

collocations: apply pattern matching to a value

words.enDefinition: a Python statement that tries ordered patterns against a subject and runs the first applicable case

examples.en: Our match statement picked a drawing command by comparing the record with several permitted shapes.
examples.zh: 我们的「match 匹配语句」将记录与若干允许的结构比较，据此挑选绘图指令。

examples.en: The teacher added a final case to the match statement for inputs with unrecognised structures.
examples.zh: 老师给「match 匹配语句」加了最后一个分支，处理无法识别结构的输入。

collocations: add a case to a match statement

words.enDefinition: an extra condition checked after a pattern matches to determine whether its branch runs

examples.en: The pattern guard checked that the captured width was positive before running the matching case.
examples.zh: 「模式守卫」先检查捕获的宽度是否大于零，再决定是否执行匹配分支。

examples.en: We wrote a pattern guard to accept paired coordinates only when they described a point inside the page.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「模式守卫」，只接收表示页面内位置的坐标对。

words.enDefinition: a pattern that compares a subject with a literal such as a specified number or string

examples.en: The first literal pattern matched the exact word that meant the museum was closed that day.
examples.zh: 第一个「字面量模式」匹配那个表示博物馆当天闭馆的特定单词。

examples.en: Her example used a literal pattern for zero and a separate guarded case for negative values.
examples.zh: 她的例子用「字面量模式」匹配零，用另一个带守卫的分支处理负数。

collocations: compare a value against a literal pattern

words.enDefinition: a pattern that accepts an arbitrary value without binding it to a name

examples.en: A wildcard pattern caught all remaining values in the final case of our Python function.
examples.zh: 「通配模式」在 Python 函数的最后一个分支中匹配所有剩余值。

examples.en: We used a wildcard pattern to ignore the middle coordinate while keeping the other two.
examples.zh: 我们用「通配模式」忽略中间的坐标分量，同时保留另外两个。

words.enDefinition: a pattern that binds the matched value or subvalue to a name

examples.en: The Python capture pattern gave us a name for the width stored in the input record.
examples.zh: Python 的「捕获模式」让我们用一个名称引用输入记录中存的宽度。

examples.en: The student replaced the capture pattern with a wildcard because the code never used the value.
examples.zh: 学生把「捕获模式」换成了通配符，因为代码始终没使用这个值。

collocations: bind a value with a capture pattern

words.enDefinition: a pattern that matches a sequence by the structure and patterns of its ordered elements

examples.en: The sequence pattern accepted pairs and bound their two elements to the horizontal and vertical coordinates.
examples.zh: 「序列模式」接受成对的数据，并分别将两个元素绑定为横纵坐标。

examples.en: We used a sequence pattern to distinguish a list of three scores from a single value.
examples.zh: 我们用「序列模式」把含三个分数的列表与单个值区分开。

collocations: use a starred name in a sequence pattern

words.enDefinition: a pattern that matches a mapping by looking for specified keys and matching their associated values

examples.en: The mapping pattern matched records with a title and captured the corresponding title for printing.
examples.zh: 「映射模式」匹配包含标题的记录，并捕获对应的标题用于输出。

examples.en: Our Python example used a mapping pattern to find entries containing both room and time fields.
examples.zh: 我们的 Python 示例用「映射模式」查找同时含有房间和时间字段的条目。

collocations: look for keys in a mapping pattern

words.enDefinition: a pattern that succeeds when any of its component patterns matches

examples.en: The OR pattern let the same branch handle records that contained either of two approved labels.
examples.zh: 「或模式」让同一个分支处理含有两个准许标签之一的记录。

examples.en: We combined the two literal alternatives into one OR pattern before rerunning the class exercise.
examples.zh: 再次运行课堂练习前，我们把两个字面量选项合成一个「或模式」。

collocations: combine alternatives in an OR pattern

words.enDefinition: a pattern that cannot fail to match any subject in the applicable language

examples.en: The final Python case used an irrefutable pattern to handle any value the earlier cases had missed.
examples.zh: Python 最后一个分支用「不可反驳模式」接收前面分支没匹配的任何值。

examples.en: Our tutor moved the irrefutable pattern to the end because its unguarded case would always match.
examples.zh: 导师把「不可反驳模式」移到末尾，因为它不加守卫就总会匹配。

words.enDefinition: the statements inside a loop that are eligible to run on each iteration

examples.en: The loop body printed each student's score before adding it to the total for the class.
examples.zh: 「循环体」先打印每名学生的分数，再把它加进全班总分。

examples.en: We moved the counter update into the loop body so it would happen on each pass.
examples.zh: 我们把计数器更新移进「循环体」，让每次迭代都更新计数。

collocations: skip the rest of the loop body

words.enDefinition: a condition that controls whether a conditional loop starts or continues another iteration

examples.en: Our loop condition ended the loop after enough valid measurements had been added to the list.
examples.zh: 列表加入足够多的有效测量值后，我们的「循环条件」让程序退出循环。

examples.en: The loop condition now checks the number of samples before starting each pass through the readings.
examples.zh: 现在「循环条件」在每轮处理读数前检查样本数量。

words.enDefinition: the event of leaving a loop because its work is complete or another exit condition occurs

examples.en: We demonstrated loop termination by processing the final valid entry in the supplied list of names.
examples.zh: 我们处理了给定姓名列表中最后一条有效记录，以演示「循环终止」。

examples.en: The assignment asked us to justify loop termination when the counter started at any positive integer.
examples.zh: 作业要求我们说明计数器从任意正整数开始时，为何能够实现「循环终止」。

words.enDefinition: a loop that iterates over an iterable or uses explicit control expressions, depending on the language

examples.en: A for loop displayed the shelf label associated with each book in the inventory list.
examples.zh: 一个「for 循环」显示了库存清单里每本书对应的书架标签。

examples.en: The original for loop counted from one through ten before printing the table of results.
examples.zh: 原先的「for 循环」从一数到十，然后输出结果表。

collocations: iterate over a list with a for loop

words.enDefinition: a loop that checks its condition before each iteration and runs its body when the condition holds

examples.en: Our while loop asked for another reading until enough valid observations were available for the calculation.
examples.zh: 在拿到足够的有效观测值供计算之前，我们的「while 循环」会要求继续输入读数。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the while loop would run if the queue was empty at the start.
examples.zh: 导师问，如果队列一开始就是空的，「while 循环」的循环体会不会执行。

words.enDefinition: a loop that executes its body before checking whether another iteration should run

examples.en: The do-while loop displayed the menu once before checking whether the user wanted to see it again.
examples.zh: 「do-while 循环」先显示了一次菜单，再检查用户是否想重新查看。

examples.en: We chose a do-while loop because the program needed one reading before it could test the condition.
examples.zh: 我们选择「do-while 循环」，因为程序必须先取得一条读数才能判断条件。

collocations: compare a do-while loop with a while loop

words.enDefinition: a loop that visits elements of a collection without requiring the programmer to manage a numerical index

examples.en: A for-each loop printed each line in the report without referring to its position in the list.
examples.zh: 「逐元素循环」逐行打印报告，无需引用各行在列表中的位置。

examples.en: We replaced the index-based code with a for-each loop because only the item names were needed.
examples.zh: 只需要各项的名称，所以我们将基于索引的代码换成了「逐元素循环」。

collocations: traverse a collection with a for-each loop

words.enDefinition: a variable whose value is set or updated as a loop moves through iterations

examples.en: The loop variable held a room name each time the Python example processed another booking.
examples.zh: 每处理下一条预订，Python 示例的「循环变量」就保存一个房间名。

examples.en: We renamed the loop variable to make it clear that each value represented a temperature.
examples.zh: 我们给「循环变量」改名，让读者看得出每个值都表示温度。

collocations: assign a value to a loop variable

words.enDefinition: a variable used to count repetitions or to control a loop by changing on each pass

examples.en: The loop counter increased after each valid result so the summary recorded the number of completed trials.
examples.zh: 每产生一个有效结果，「循环计数器」就增加一次，因此汇总记录了已完成的试验次数。

examples.en: We reset the loop counter before repeating the exercise with a new set of sample readings.
examples.zh: 我们重置了「循环计数器」，再用一组新的样本读数重复练习。

words.enDefinition: the changing position used by a loop to access an item in an indexed sequence

examples.en: Our loop index selected the corresponding price from the array during each pass through the products.
examples.zh: 每轮处理产品时，我们用「循环索引」从数组里选出对应的价格。

examples.en: The tutor checked where the loop index first exceeded the last valid position of the array.
examples.zh: 导师检查了「循环索引」在何处首次超过数组的最后一个有效位置。

collocations: read an item at the loop index
compare the loop index with the array length

words.enDefinition: a loop whose continuation is determined by the value of a counter

examples.en: The counter-controlled loop ran the same demonstration exactly eight times before displaying the average result.
examples.zh: 「计数控制循环」将同一演示恰好运行八次，再显示平均结果。

examples.en: We used a counter-controlled loop to fill a table with a fixed number of sample rows.
examples.zh: 我们用「计数控制循环」向表中填入固定行数的样本数据。

words.enDefinition: setting a loop's starting state before its first condition check or iteration

examples.en: The C example used loop initialisation to set the index to zero before checking the first condition.
examples.zh: C 语言示例通过「循环初始化」把索引设为零，再检查第一次循环条件。

examples.en: We moved loop initialisation outside the repeated work so the counter no longer reset on every pass.
examples.zh: 我们把「循环初始化」移出了重复执行的部分，避免计数器在每轮开始时重置。

collocations: set the starting index during loop initialisation

words.enDefinition: a loop that continues until it encounters a designated value indicating that processing should stop

examples.en: The sentinel-controlled loop read scores until a reserved input indicated there were no more entries to process.
examples.zh: 「哨兵控制循环」持续读取分数，直到保留的输入表示没有下一条记录。

examples.en: We added a prompt before each read in the sentinel-controlled loop used for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习的「哨兵控制循环」里，每次读取前都加了一条提示。

words.enDefinition: a loop that does not end through its own normal control logic

examples.en: The notebook kernel stayed busy because an infinite loop kept processing the same row without advancing.
examples.zh: 「无限循环」不断处理同一行数据，始终没有前进，笔记本内核因此一直处于忙碌状态。

examples.en: We found the infinite loop after noticing that the counter never changed on the empty input path.
examples.zh: 我们注意到空输入路径上计数器一直不变，由此发现了「无限循环」。

words.enDefinition: a loop contained within another loop

examples.en: The nested loop processed every seat in each row of the diagram for the theatre.
examples.zh: 「嵌套循环」处理剧院示意图中每一排的每个座位。

examples.en: We traced the nested loop by writing down which row and column were visited at each step.
examples.zh: 我们记录每一步访问的行和列，以跟踪「嵌套循环」。

words.enDefinition: the loop containing another loop within its body

examples.en: The outer loop selected a worksheet while the inner code read the rows belonging to that sheet.
examples.zh: 「外层循环」选择工作表，内层代码则读取所选表中的行。

examples.en: We moved the row total into the outer loop so each department would get a separate result.
examples.zh: 我们把行合计移入「外层循环」，让每个部门得到独立的结果。

collocations: break out of the outer loop

words.enDefinition: a loop contained in the body of another loop

examples.en: The inner loop counted the occupied seats for the row selected by the outer loop.
examples.zh: 「内层循环」统计外层循环选中那一排中已占用的座位。

examples.en: Most of the exercise's work happened inside the inner loop because it compared every pair of items.
examples.zh: 练习的大部分运算发生在「内层循环」中，因为它要比较每一对条目。

collocations: move work out of the inner loop

words.enDefinition: one pass through the repeated body or work of a loop

examples.en: Each loop iteration added one day's rainfall figure to the total for the whole month.
examples.zh: 每次「循环迭代」都把一天的降雨量加到整月总量里。

examples.en: We recorded the value of the counter at the end of each loop iteration in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习时我们记下每次「循环迭代」结束时计数器的值。

words.enDefinition: a limit used to determine which values or how many iterations a loop can process

examples.en: An incorrect loop bound made the program stop just before processing the final item in the array.
examples.zh: 错误的「循环边界」使程序在处理数组最后一项之前停了下来。

examples.en: We set the loop bound using the actual number of readings held in the file.
examples.zh: 我们按文件实际保存的读数条数设定了「循环边界」。

words.enDefinition: an upper limit that is excluded from the permitted values

examples.en: We used an exclusive upper bound so the range stopped immediately before reaching the number of items.
examples.zh: 我们使用「不包含端点的上界」，让范围恰好在达到条目数之前结束。

examples.en: The documentation called ten the exclusive upper bound even though nine was the largest selectable integer.
examples.zh: 文档把十称为「不包含端点的上界」，尽管可选的最大整数是九。

collocations: compare a value with an exclusive upper bound

words.enDefinition: a statement that exits an enclosing loop or another breakable construct allowed by the language

examples.en: The break statement ended the search after the program found the first matching book in the list.
examples.zh: 程序找到列表中第一本匹配的书后，「break 跳出语句」结束了搜索。

examples.en: We placed the break statement inside the branch that handled an input ending the session.
examples.zh: 我们把「break 跳出语句」放到处理会话结束输入的分支中。

collocations: exit a loop with a break statement

words.enDefinition: a statement that skips the rest of the current loop iteration and resumes the loop's control process

examples.en: A continue statement skipped the current row when the required date was missing from the spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 表格缺少必填日期时，「continue 跳过本轮语句」跳过了当前行。

examples.en: We added a continue statement before the calculation so blank responses would never reach the total.
examples.zh: 我们在计算前加了一条「continue 跳过本轮语句」，这样空白答复不会被计入总数。

collocations: skip the remaining work with a continue statement

words.enDefinition: an optional Python clause executed when a loop finishes normally, without exiting through break

examples.en: The loop else clause printed a message saying none of the stored book titles matched the search.
examples.zh: 「循环的 else 子句」输出了一条提示，说所存书目中没有匹配项。

examples.en: We traced why a successful lookup bypassed the loop else clause after the loop executed its break.
examples.zh: 我们跟踪了为什么成功查到结果后，循环执行 break 并跳过了「循环的 else 子句」。

words.enDefinition: a mistake in which a boundary, count or index is one above or below the intended value

examples.en: An off-by-one error let the program try to read one position past the last recorded result.
examples.zh: 一处「差一错误」让程序尝试读取最后一个记录结果之后的位置。

examples.en: We found the off-by-one error after the report counted the opening day twice in its total.
examples.zh: 报告把开放首日计入总数两次后，我们找到了这处「差一错误」。

words.enDefinition: code creating a function and specifying its behaviour, typically including parameters and a body

examples.en: The function definition showed how the program converted a measurement before returning the result to the caller.
examples.zh: 「函数定义」展示了程序如何换算测量值，再把结果返回给调用方。

examples.en: We moved the function definition above the test code so the routine existed before the first call.
examples.zh: 我们将「函数定义」移到测试代码的上方，使该例程在第一次调用前已经定义。

collocations: separate a function definition from its calls

words.enDefinition: an expression or action that invokes a function, passing any arguments required by that function

examples.en: The function call passed the selected date to the routine that formatted dates for the printed schedule.
examples.zh: 这次「函数调用」把所选日期传给了为印刷日程表设置日期格式的例程。

examples.en: We replaced a repeated calculation with a function call to the helper we had already tested.
examples.zh: 我们用对已测试辅助函数的「函数调用」替换了重复的计算。

words.enDefinition: a construct that introduces a function name and specifies part or all of its definition, depending on the language

examples.en: The C example placed a function declaration above the first call and defined its body farther down.
examples.zh: C 语言示例将「函数声明」放在首次调用之前，并在后面定义函数体。

examples.en: The JavaScript lesson compared a function declaration with a function written as part of another expression.
examples.zh: JavaScript 课将「函数声明」与写在另一表达式中的函数作了比较。

collocations: check a function declaration against its definition

words.enDefinition: an expression in which evaluating the code produces a function value

examples.en: We assigned the result of a function expression to a local name in the example.
examples.zh: 我们将一个「函数表达式」的求值结果赋给了局部名称。

examples.en: We passed a function expression directly to the sorting method to specify how ties should be handled.
examples.zh: 我们把「函数表达式」直接传给排序方法，说明如何处理同序的条目。

collocations: pass a function expression as an argument

words.enDefinition: a JavaScript function expression written with an arrow token, with lexical binding for this

examples.en: We used an arrow function to convert the list of hours into a new list of minutes.
examples.zh: 我们用「箭头函数」把以小时计的时长列表换算成新的分钟列表。

examples.en: The tutor showed why the arrow function used the surrounding value of this in the given example.
examples.zh: 导师说明了给定示例里的「箭头函数」为什么使用外层的 this 值。

collocations: pass an arrow function as a callback
write an arrow function with an expression body

words.enDefinition: a function created without giving it an explicit name in its definition

examples.en: An anonymous function converted each label to lowercase before the programme compared it with the search term.
examples.zh: 「匿名函数」将各标签转成小写，程序再将其与搜索词比较。

examples.en: We used an anonymous function because the comparison was short and called from only one place.
examples.zh: 比较逻辑很短，而且只有一处调用，所以我们用「匿名函数」。

collocations: use an anonymous function as a callback

words.enDefinition: an expression that creates a function value using a language's lambda syntax

examples.en: A Python lambda expression returned the second element of each pair as the key for sorting.
examples.zh: Python 的「Lambda 表达式」返回各数据对的第二个元素作为排序键。

examples.en: We replaced the long lambda expression with a named function so the validation logic was easier to read.
examples.zh: 我们把很长的「Lambda 表达式」换成具名函数，让校验逻辑更好读。

collocations: pass a lambda expression as an argument

words.enDefinition: a function that takes at least one function as an argument, returns a function, or does both

examples.en: The higher-order function accepted a predicate function for deciding which survey responses should appear in its results.
examples.zh: 「高阶函数」接收一个谓词函数，用它决定哪些调查答复应列入结果。

examples.en: We wrote a higher-order function that returned a different formatting routine for each supported output style.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「高阶函数」，为每种支持的输出样式返回不同的格式化例程。

collocations: pass a function to a higher-order function

words.enDefinition: a function treated as a value that can be assigned, passed to other functions or returned

examples.en: A first-class function can be stored in the table of formatters alongside several other available formatting options.
examples.zh: 「一等函数」可以与其他可选格式化方法一起存到格式化函数表里。

examples.en: Our tutor used a first-class function as the return value in a short exercise about choosing behaviour.
examples.zh: 在一个选择行为的小练习中，导师把「一等函数」作为返回值。

collocations: treat a function as a first-class function
pass a first-class function as an argument

words.enDefinition: a function supplied to other code so that code can invoke it at an appropriate point

examples.en: The callback function saved each processed record after the routine finished converting its date and amount fields.
examples.zh: 例程转换完每条记录的日期和金额字段后，「回调函数」保存了这条处理好的记录。

examples.en: We passed a callback function that compared the two names whenever the sorting routine needed an ordering.
examples.zh: 排序例程每次需要确定顺序时，就调用我们传入的「回调函数」比较两个名称。

words.enDefinition: the statements or expression that specify the work performed when a function runs

examples.en: The function body first checked that the input list was nonempty, then calculated the mean of its values.
examples.zh: 「函数体」先检查输入列表非空，再计算其中数值的平均数。

examples.en: We shortened the function body by moving the date formatting code into a separate helper function.
examples.zh: 我们把日期格式处理代码移到另一个辅助函数里，缩短了「函数体」。

words.enDefinition: a name in a function definition that receives an argument or otherwise binds an input value

examples.en: The formal parameter named units held whichever measurement unit the caller supplied to the conversion routine.
examples.zh: 调用方把什么计量单位传给转换例程，名为 units 的「形式参数」就会保存什么单位。

examples.en: We renamed the formal parameter to distinguish the measurement itself from the name of the person recording it.
examples.zh: 我们给「形式参数」改名，以区分测量值本身与记录人的姓名。

collocations: bind an argument to a formal parameter

words.enDefinition: a value or expression supplied in a call to serve as input to a function

examples.en: The first actual argument was the number read from the form when the student submitted it.
examples.zh: 学生提交表单时读取的数字是第一个「实际参数」。

examples.en: We compared each actual argument with the corresponding parameter listed at the start of the definition.
examples.zh: 我们把每个「实际参数」与定义开头列出的相应参数作了比较。

collocations: match an actual argument to a parameter

words.enDefinition: an argument matched to a parameter according to its position in the call

examples.en: The first positional argument supplied the starting date for the schedule generated by the example function.
examples.zh: 第一个「位置实参」给出了示例函数生成日程表所用的开始日期。

examples.en: We swapped two positional argument values and noticed that the meeting's start time changed in the output.
examples.zh: 我们调换两个「位置实参」的值后，发现输出里的会议开始时间改变了。

words.enDefinition: an argument supplied by naming the corresponding parameter, as supported by the language

examples.en: A keyword argument specified the output language while the other settings remained at their default values.
examples.zh: 一个「关键字实参」指定了输出语言，其余设置仍用默认值。

examples.en: We used a keyword argument to make the meaning of the date format clear at the call site.
examples.zh: 我们用「关键字实参」明确调用处设置日期格式的意图。

collocations: specify an option as a keyword argument

words.enDefinition: the value used for a parameter when the caller does not supply the corresponding argument

examples.en: The default argument value limited the report to ten rows when the caller omitted that setting.
examples.zh: 调用方没提供该设置时，「默认参数值」把报告限定为十行。

examples.en: We changed the default argument value so a short label would appear when none was supplied.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「默认参数值」，使没有提供标签时显示一个简短的标签。

words.enDefinition: a parameter for which a caller is allowed to omit the corresponding argument

examples.en: An optional parameter let us include the building address when the schedule needed more detail.
examples.zh: 日程表需要更多细节时，可通过一个「可选形参」纳入建筑地址。

examples.en: We made the frame colour an optional parameter because most callers used the same colour.
examples.zh: 我们把边框颜色设成「可选形参」，因为大部分调用方都用同一种颜色。

collocations: read the default for an optional parameter

words.enDefinition: a parameter for which the caller must supply an argument for the call to be valid

examples.en: The timetable routine used the date as a required parameter when generating the list of available rooms.
examples.zh: 生成可用房间列表时，日程表例程把日期设为「必填形参」。

examples.en: We checked the documentation and saw that the room number was a required parameter for this function.
examples.zh: 我们查了文档，发现房间编号是这个函数的「必填形参」。

collocations: provide a value for a required parameter

words.zhGloss: 仅限按位置传入的形参
words.enDefinition: a parameter that must be supplied by position and may not be named as a keyword argument
acceptedZhAnswers: 仅限按位置传入的形参

examples.en: The tutor marked the first input as a positional-only parameter so callers had to pass it by position.
examples.zh: 导师把第一个输入标为「仅限按位置传入的形参」，因此调用方必须按位置传入它。

examples.en: The example raised an error when we supplied the positional-only parameter by name instead of by position.
examples.zh: 我们尝试按名称传入「仅限按位置传入的形参」时，示例抛出了错误。

collocations: pass a value to a positional-only parameter

words.zhGloss: 仅限按关键字传入的形参
words.enDefinition: a parameter whose argument, if supplied, must be associated with the parameter name instead of its position
acceptedZhAnswers: 仅限按关键字传入的形参

examples.en: The function declared a keyword-only parameter for the output folder to make each call easier to read.
examples.zh: 函数把输出文件夹声明为「仅限按关键字传入的形参」，使每次调用更容易看懂。

examples.en: We used a keyword-only parameter for orientation because callers might forget what a second positional value meant.
examples.zh: 我们用「仅限按关键字传入的形参」表示方向，因为调用方可能忘记第二个位置值的含义。

collocations: pass an argument to a keyword-only parameter

words.enDefinition: a list of supplied arguments whose length is permitted to vary from one call to another

examples.en: The routine used a variable-length argument list because it could total any number of individual readings.
examples.zh: 例程使用「可变长度实参列表」，因为它可以对任意数量的单条读数求和。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated a variable-length argument list by calling the same function with two and four inputs.
examples.zh: 导师分别使用两个和四个输入调用同一函数，以演示「可变长度实参列表」。

words.enDefinition: expanding values in a collection into separate arguments for a function call

examples.en: The Python script used argument unpacking to pass each coordinate to the appropriate parameter of the drawing routine.
examples.zh: Python 脚本用「实参解包」将每个坐标传给绘图例程的对应形参。

examples.en: We tested argument unpacking with a dictionary whose keys matched the parameter names used in the example.
examples.zh: 我们用一个键名与示例形参名一致的字典测试「实参解包」。

collocations: apply argument unpacking at a call
combine argument unpacking with explicit arguments

words.enDefinition: in JavaScript, the final parameter declared with an ellipsis to collect remaining arguments into an array

examples.en: The rest parameter collected all the labels supplied after the first argument named the worksheet in the call.
examples.zh: 这次调用的第一个实参指定工作表名称，「剩余形参」收集了其后传入的所有标签。

examples.en: We iterated over the rest parameter to display every note the caller had supplied after the date.
examples.zh: 我们遍历「剩余形参」，显示调用方在日期之后给出的每条备注。

words.enDefinition: associating the arguments supplied in a call with the appropriate parameters of the function

examples.en: The tutor illustrated argument binding by showing which parameter received each of the three values in our call.
examples.zh: 导师展示调用中的三个值分别传给哪个形参，以讲解「实参与形参绑定」。

examples.en: An argument binding error occurred because the same parameter received both a positional value and a keyword value.
examples.zh: 同一形参既收到了位置值又收到了关键字值，导致「实参与形参绑定」出错。

words.enDefinition: the name and parameter information identifying a function or describing how it can be called, according to the language

examples.en: We inspected the function signature to see which arguments the caller could omit.
examples.zh: 我们查看「函数签名」，确认调用方可以省略哪些实参。

examples.en: The editor showed the function signature after we changed the order of its parameters.
examples.zh: 我们调整形参顺序后，编辑器显示了更新的「函数签名」。

words.enDefinition: a statement ending the current function call and optionally supplying a result to its caller

examples.en: The return statement sent the calculated average back to the part of the program displaying the report.
examples.zh: 「return 返回语句」把计算出的平均值传回程序中负责显示报告的部分。

examples.en: We moved the return statement outside the loop so the function could process every row first.
examples.zh: 我们把「return 返回语句」移到循环外面，让函数先处理完所有行。

words.enDefinition: the value delivered to the caller when a function call completes normally

examples.en: We used the return value as the title for the page generated from the selected date.
examples.zh: 我们把「返回值」用作根据所选日期生成的页面标题。

examples.en: The test compared the return value with the expected temperature in the units requested by the caller.
examples.zh: 测试把「返回值」与调用方所要求单位下的预期温度作了比较。

collocations: compare a return value with the expected result

words.enDefinition: returning a value automatically without an explicit return statement for that result

examples.en: The JavaScript example used an implicit return in an arrow function whose body was a single expression.
examples.zh: JavaScript 示例的箭头函数体是单个表达式，因此采用「隐式返回」。

examples.en: The class discussed the implicit return of None when a Python function reached the end of its body.
examples.zh: 全班讨论了 Python 函数运行到函数体末尾时对 None 的「隐式返回」。

collocations: replace an implicit return with a return statement

words.enDefinition: ending a function call by executing a return statement rather than through automatic completion

examples.en: An explicit return made it clear that the function should deliver the total to its caller.
examples.zh: 「显式返回」清楚表明，函数应将合计值交给调用方。

examples.en: We added an explicit return after calculation because the caller needed the number for another step.
examples.zh: 调用方还需要这个数字完成下一步，所以我们在计算之后加了「显式返回」。

words.enDefinition: a return executed before a function reaches its main logic or the end of its body

examples.en: The early return prevented the function from computing an average when the list had no valid readings.
examples.zh: 列表没有有效读数时，「提前返回」避免了函数继续计算平均值。

examples.en: We used an early return for the special case where both intervals were already known to match.
examples.zh: 两个区间已知匹配是一种特殊情况，我们对此采用了「提前返回」。

collocations: handle an empty input with an early return

words.enDefinition: returning one tuple that groups several components for the caller to use

examples.en: The tuple return supplied the first and last dates found in the set of sample readings.
examples.zh: 这个函数「以元组形式返回」样本读数中的最早和最晚日期。

examples.en: We replaced the tuple return with a named record because the order of its three values was confusing.
examples.zh: 由于三个值的顺序容易弄混，我们用具名记录替换了「以元组形式返回」。

collocations: replace a tuple return with a named record

words.enDefinition: the location in code where a call to a function or other callable is made

examples.en: The tutor marked the call site where the program first asked the date helper to format a label.
examples.zh: 导师标出了程序第一次使用日期辅助函数设置标签格式的「调用处」。

examples.en: We checked every call site after adding an optional parameter to the routine that reads dates.
examples.zh: 给读取日期的例程增加可选形参后，我们检查了每一处「调用处」。

words.enDefinition: a runtime structure tracking active calls, typically with the most recently entered call at the top

examples.en: The nested calls appeared on the call stack in the order shown by the classroom example.
examples.zh: 各层嵌套调用按课堂示例所示的顺序出现在「调用栈」上。

examples.en: We checked the call stack to find which routine had called the formatter before execution paused.
examples.zh: 我们查看「调用栈」，查出执行暂停之前哪个例程调用了格式化函数。

collocations: push a frame onto the call stack

words.enDefinition: a call in which a function invokes itself directly or through another function

examples.en: Each recursive call handled a smaller portion of the input before combining its result with the remaining work.
examples.zh: 每次「递归调用」先处理更小的一部分输入，再把结果与余下工作合并。

examples.en: The tutor traced another recursive call to see when the routine first reached a single remaining item.
examples.zh: 导师跟踪了下一次「递归调用」，查看例程何时首次只剩一项要处理。

words.enDefinition: recursion in which two or more functions call each other, directly or through a cycle

examples.en: Our tutor used mutual recursion to show how two routines could alternate as they processed the same sequence.
examples.zh: 导师用「相互递归」演示两个例程可以如何交替处理同一序列。

examples.en: The parser used mutual recursion so its helpers could take turns processing nested parts of an expression.
examples.zh: 解析器用「相互递归」让两个辅助函数交替处理表达式的嵌套部分。

collocations: replace mutual recursion with an iterative routine

words.enDefinition: the part of a recursive definition that invokes the same task again with a different input

examples.en: The recursive case processed the remaining items after taking the first item from the list.
examples.zh: 「递归情形」让函数从列表中取走首项之后继续处理余下条目。

examples.en: In the recursive case, each call received a smaller number until the routine reached the stopping condition.
examples.zh: 在「递归情形」下，每次调用接到一个更小的数，直到例程达到终止条件。

collocations: reduce the input in the recursive case

words.enDefinition: the number of simultaneously active recursive levels of a computation at a given point

examples.en: We recorded the recursion depth to see how many calls were still active at the deepest point.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「递归深度」，了解在最深处有多少层调用仍未返回。

examples.en: The program reached its recursion depth limit because the input caused too many calls before returning.
examples.zh: 输入导致调用在返回之前嵌套过多，因此程序达到了「递归深度」上限。

words.enDefinition: scope determined by where code and declarations are written in the program's source

examples.en: The diagram explained lexical scope by showing which names a nested function could find in the surrounding code.
examples.zh: 示意图展示嵌套函数可以在外层代码中找到哪些名称，以说明「词法作用域」。

examples.en: We used lexical scope rules to tell which version of the same name the formatter would use.
examples.zh: 我们用「词法作用域」规则判断格式化函数会使用同名变量的哪一个版本。

collocations: resolve a name through lexical scope
compare lexical scope with dynamic scope

words.enDefinition: the region inside a function or other construct where the language resolves a name to a binding declared in that region

examples.en: The formatter kept the temporary text in local scope so the wider program could not refer to it.
examples.zh: 格式化函数把临时文本放在「局部作用域」，使程序其他部分无法引用它。

examples.en: Our example showed how a name in local scope could hide another name used by surrounding code.
examples.zh: 示例演示了「局部作用域」中的一个名字如何遮蔽外层代码所用的同名变量。

collocations: define a name in local scope
resolve a name in local scope
keep a variable in local scope

words.enDefinition: the outermost scope for ordinary named declarations under a language's execution rules

examples.en: We moved the constant into global scope so multiple functions in the Python module could read it.
examples.zh: 我们把常量放进「全局作用域」，这样 Python 模块中的多个函数都能读取它。

examples.en: The JavaScript tutor distinguished global scope from the scope of variables declared at the top of a module.
examples.zh: JavaScript 导师区分了「全局作用域」与位于模块顶层的变量的作用域。

collocations: define a name in global scope

words.enDefinition: a scope surrounding the current scope in the source structure

examples.en: The nested function read the selected unit from its enclosing scope on every call in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的嵌套函数每次调用都从其「外层作用域」读取所选单位。

examples.en: We located the enclosing scope before deciding which declaration supplied the label seen by the nested code.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「外层作用域」，再判断嵌套代码看到的标签来自哪条声明。

collocations: look up a name in an enclosing scope
update a binding in an enclosing scope

words.enDefinition: a name association in an enclosing function scope, accessed with nonlocal when rebinding it in Python

examples.en: The nested Python function used a nonlocal binding to update the count shared with its outer function.
examples.zh: 嵌套 Python 函数通过「非局部名称绑定」更新与外层函数共享的计数。

examples.en: We marked the nonlocal binding to distinguish it from a variable local to the inner function.
examples.zh: 我们标出了「非局部名称绑定」，把它与内层函数自己的局部变量区别开。

words.enDefinition: finding which binding a reference to a name should use under the language's scope rules

examples.en: The exercise traced name lookup from the innermost function to a matching declaration in the surrounding function.
examples.zh: 练习演示了从最内层函数向外进行「名称查找」，直到在其外层函数中找到匹配的声明。

examples.en: We reviewed the name lookup rules to explain why the code kept finding the value from the module.
examples.zh: 我们查阅了「名称查找」规则，解释代码为什么总是找到模块里的值。

words.enDefinition: using the same name for an inner binding so references there no longer select an outer binding

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated name shadowing by giving a local variable the same name as a module constant.
examples.zh: 导师给局部变量取了与模块常量相同的名字，以演示「名称遮蔽」。

examples.en: We avoided name shadowing by choosing a parameter name different from the name used by the outer function.
examples.zh: 我们选择与外层函数所用名称不同的形参名，避免「名称遮蔽」。

words.enDefinition: a function together with access to the bindings in its lexical environment

examples.en: The lexical closure preserved access to the chosen prefix after the function that created it had returned.
examples.zh: 创建它的函数返回之后，「词法闭包」仍能访问已选定的前缀。

examples.en: We built a lexical closure whose inner function read a different display setting for each returned formatter.
examples.zh: 我们构建了一个「词法闭包」，其中的内层函数会为各返回的格式化器读取不同的显示设置。

collocations: explain how a lexical closure retains access to bindings

words.enDefinition: a variable from an outer scope that a function retains access to through its closure

examples.en: The returned function read a captured variable holding the label prefix supplied to the outer routine.
examples.zh: 返回的函数读取了一个「捕获的变量」，它保存传入外层例程的标签前缀。

examples.en: We changed the captured variable and checked whether the two callbacks still referred to the same binding.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「捕获的变量」，再检查两个回调是否仍引用同一个绑定。

collocations: preserve access to a captured variable

words.enDefinition: a function that produces the same result for the same inputs and has no observable side effects

examples.en: The pure function converted the temperatures without updating the list that the caller had passed into it.
examples.zh: 「纯函数」换算了温度，没有修改调用方传入的列表。

examples.en: We tested the pure function with the same measurements twice and received the same formatted result.
examples.zh: 我们用相同测量值对「纯函数」测试两次，得到同一格式化结果。

collocations: test a pure function in isolation
refactor a calculation into a pure function

words.enDefinition: a function that has an observable side effect or whose output can vary for the same inputs

examples.en: The tutor called it an impure function because it wrote a message into the shared activity log.
examples.zh: 这个函数会往共享活动日志里写一条消息，所以导师称它为「非纯函数」。

examples.en: We tested the impure function with a fixed clock because it normally read the current time.
examples.zh: 我们用固定时钟测试「非纯函数」，因为它通常会读取当前时间。

words.enDefinition: an observable effect beyond returning a result, such as writing output or changing shared state

examples.en: Writing a row to the file was an observable side effect of calling the example function.
examples.zh: 调用示例函数会向文件写一行，这是一个「可观察的副作用」。

examples.en: The test checked for an observable side effect by comparing the shared list before and after the call.
examples.zh: 测试通过对比调用前后的共享列表，检查是否有「可观察的副作用」。

words.enDefinition: combining functions so the result of one function serves as the input to another

examples.en: The exercise used function composition to trim a label before passing it to the formatter.
examples.zh: 练习用「函数复合」先去掉标签首尾的空白，再把标签传给格式化器。

examples.en: We drew the order of evaluation for function composition using three short text filters from the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用练习里的三个简短文字过滤函数画出了「函数复合」的求值顺序。

words.enDefinition: a unit of code that groups related definitions and can expose them for use elsewhere

examples.en: We put the date helpers into one module so that the worksheet and report scripts could share them.
examples.zh: 我们把日期辅助函数放进同一「模块」，让练习表脚本和报告脚本共用。

examples.en: The module provided functions for formatting dates but left the menu generation to another part of the program.
examples.zh: 该「模块」提供日期格式化函数，将生成菜单的工作交给程序的另一部分。

words.enDefinition: the set of names bound to objects within a module

examples.en: The names in the module namespace included the helper we defined and the library we imported earlier.
examples.zh: 「模块命名空间」中的名称包括我们定义的辅助函数和之前导入的库。

examples.en: We checked whether the identifier had been added to our module namespace before trying to use it.
examples.zh: 尝试使用该标识符前，我们先检查它是否已加入我们的「模块命名空间」。

collocations: add a name to a module namespace
resolve a name in a module namespace

words.enDefinition: a Python package that can combine portions from more than one import location without a package initializer file

examples.en: We used a namespace package to let two independent distributions contribute separate modules under one package name.
examples.zh: 我们用「命名空间包」，使两个独立发行包能在同一个包名下提供不同模块。

examples.en: The example's namespace package had parts in two folders that Python could see on its import path.
examples.zh: 示例的「命名空间包」分布在 Python 导入路径可见的两个文件夹中。

collocations: distribute parts of a namespace package
import a module from a namespace package

words.enDefinition: a statement that refers to a module and may bind names from it for use by the importing code

examples.en: The import statement made the shared formatting helper available to the part of the program that printed labels.
examples.zh: 「导入语句」让程序中负责打印标签的部分可以使用共用的格式化辅助函数。

examples.en: We changed the import statement after moving the helper into a separate file within the package.
examples.zh: 把辅助函数移到包内的另一个文件后，我们修改了「导入语句」。

collocations: resolve the module in an import statement

words.enDefinition: importing specific named members provided by a module rather than making the module itself or all its public names available

examples.en: A selective import brought in only the routine needed to convert the dates stored in the table.
examples.zh: 「选择性导入」只引入了换算表格里日期所需的例程。

examples.en: We used a selective import in the Python exercise so that formatting had one clearly identified dependency.
examples.zh: 我们在 Python 练习中使用「选择性导入」，让格式化功能只有一个清楚标明的依赖。

collocations: replace a wildcard import with a selective import

words.enDefinition: an alternative local name assigned to a module or member during import

examples.en: The import alias gave the formatting module a shorter name in the small examples used during class.
examples.zh: 「导入别名」让格式化模块在课堂小示例中能用更短的名字。

examples.en: We added an import alias because the new helper otherwise shared a name with an existing function.
examples.zh: 新辅助函数原先和一个现有函数同名，所以我们加了「导入别名」。

collocations: rename a module with an import alias

words.enDefinition: an import that specifies the target relative to the importing module's package or location

examples.en: The relative import located a formatting helper in a neighbouring module of the same Python package.
examples.zh: 「相对导入」找到了同一 Python 包中相邻模块里的格式化辅助函数。

examples.en: We changed the relative import after moving the importing file one level deeper inside the package.
examples.zh: 把发起导入的文件在包内下移一级后，我们修改了「相对导入」。

words.enDefinition: an import that identifies its target from an established starting namespace rather than the importing module's location

examples.en: The absolute import named the Python package and the module containing its date conversion routine.
examples.zh: 「绝对导入」写明了 Python 包的名字，也写明了日期转换例程所在的模块名。

examples.en: We used an absolute import so readers could recognise which package supplied the formatting routine.
examples.zh: 我们用「绝对导入」让读者能看出格式化例程来自哪个包。

words.enDefinition: an import dependency that leads from one module back to itself through other modules

examples.en: The circular import occurred because the calendar module imported the report module which imported the calendar again.
examples.zh: 日历模块导入报告模块，而报告模块又导入日历模块，形成了「循环导入」。

examples.en: We removed the circular import by moving the common text helper into an independent module.
examples.zh: 我们把共用的文本辅助函数移到一个独立模块，消除了「循环导入」。

words.enDefinition: the ordered locations Python consults when looking for importable modules

examples.en: The tutor checked the Python module search path because the interpreter could not locate the example package.
examples.zh: 解释器找不到示例包，导师检查了「Python 模块搜索路径」。

examples.en: We inspected the Python module search path to see which directory the interpreter searched before our project folder.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「Python 模块搜索路径」，了解解释器在查看项目文件夹之前先查哪个目录。

collocations: inspect the Python module search path
find a directory on the Python module search path
explain the Python module search path

words.enDefinition: a module supplied as part of a programming language's standard library

examples.en: We used a standard library module to calculate the number of days between two dates.
examples.zh: 我们用「标准库模块」计算两个日期之间的天数。

examples.en: Our example used a standard library module for generating a summary of the recorded measurements.
examples.zh: 我们的示例用「标准库模块」生成所记录测量值的汇总。

collocations: read the documentation for a standard library module

words.enDefinition: in a regular Python package, the file whose top-level code can run when that package is first imported

examples.en: Python loaded the package initializer before the example script accessed a function from one of its modules.
examples.zh: Python 先加载「包初始化文件」，示例脚本才访问包内某个模块中的函数。

examples.en: We kept the package initializer small so loading the package did not perform unrelated work.
examples.zh: 我们让「包初始化文件」保持简洁，避免加载包时做无关的工作。

words.enDefinition: a string in a JavaScript import or export statement that identifies another module for resolution

examples.en: The module specifier identified the nearby file that supplied the chart labels for our course example.
examples.zh: 「模块标识符」指向附近提供课程示例图表标签的文件。

examples.en: We corrected the module specifier after finding that the file name still referred to an older example.
examples.zh: 发现文件名仍指向旧示例后，我们修正了「模块标识符」。

words.enDefinition: an export made available under a specific name other than default in an ES module

examples.en: The named export let the other module import the date converter by the name used in its documentation.
examples.zh: 「具名导出」让另一模块可以按文档所用名称导入日期转换器。

examples.en: We added a second named export for the alternate formatting routine without changing the existing import.
examples.zh: 我们给备用格式化例程加了第二个「具名导出」，原有的导入不需要更改。

words.enDefinition: the single export identified as default in an ES module, which an importing file can bind to a local name

examples.en: The default export provided the main formatter used by both chart examples in the exercise.
examples.zh: 「默认导出」提供了练习中两个图表示例共用的主要格式化器。

examples.en: We imported the default export under a local name that described the helper's purpose in the report.
examples.zh: 我们用一个说明辅助函数在报告中用途的本地名称导入了「默认导出」。

words.enDefinition: a JavaScript module that uses the ECMAScript system for module imports and exports

examples.en: We converted the helper into an ES module and imported it from the main example file.
examples.zh: 我们把辅助函数改成「ES 模块」，在主要示例文件中导入它。

examples.en: The tutor showed that an ES module could have private names as well as visible exports.
examples.zh: 导师演示了「ES 模块」既可以有模块内部的名称，也可以对外导出名称。

collocations: export a function from an ES module

words.enDefinition: code that runs when a matching exception is raised and reaches the construct that handles it

examples.en: The exception handler displayed a useful message when the imported file contained a date with an invalid format.
examples.zh: 导入文件包含格式无效的日期时，「异常处理程序」显示了一条有帮助的提示。

examples.en: We added an exception handler for missing input so the notebook could keep processing the other files.
examples.zh: 我们为缺少输入的情况添加了「异常处理程序」，这样笔记本可以继续处理其他文件。

words.enDefinition: the process by which a raised exception passes through enclosing blocks or callers seeking a handler

examples.en: The diagram traced exception propagation from a small formatting helper to the main routine that handled it.
examples.zh: 示意图跟踪了一次「异常传播」从小型格式化辅助函数到作出处理的主例程的过程。

examples.en: Our tutor explained exception propagation after the error skipped the remaining instructions in two active functions.
examples.zh: 错误使两个活动函数的余下指令被跳过后，导师介绍了「异常传播」。

words.enDefinition: the region of code attempted under an exception-handling construct

examples.en: We put the conversion in the try block because a row might contain an incorrectly formatted date.
examples.zh: 有的行可能包含无法解析的日期，所以我们把转换放在「try 保护块」里。

examples.en: The try block covered only the file operation whose error the surrounding code intended to handle.
examples.zh: 「try 保护块」只覆盖外层代码准备处理其错误的那项文件操作。

collocations: put an operation inside a try block

words.enDefinition: a Python clause that handles exceptions of the selected type or types, or all exceptions if none are specified

examples.en: The except clause used the filename in its message after Python could not open the requested file.
examples.zh: Python 无法打开请求的文件后，「except 子句」在消息中显示了文件名。

examples.en: We narrowed the except clause to handle the error we expected from converting a malformed date.
examples.zh: 我们缩小了「except 子句」的处理范围，只处理转换格式错误的日期时预期的错误。

collocations: specify an exception type in an except clause

words.enDefinition: a block executed as control leaves its associated try construct during ordinary execution, including normal completion, a return or exception propagation

examples.en: The finally block closed the temporary file even after one line could not be read correctly.
examples.zh: 有一行没能正确读出时，「finally 清理块」仍关闭了临时文件。

examples.en: We traced when the finally block ran after the function reached a return inside the protected code.
examples.zh: 函数在受保护代码里遇到 return 后，我们跟踪了「finally 清理块」的运行时机。

collocations: put cleanup in a finally block

words.enDefinition: a Python statement that raises an exception or reraises one currently being handled

examples.en: The raise statement signalled that the supplied date range ended before its beginning in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例里，「raise 抛出语句」指出提供的日期范围结束早于开始。

examples.en: We moved the raise statement before formatting so the caller could correct the missing room number first.
examples.zh: 我们把「raise 抛出语句」移到格式化之前，让调用方先补全缺少的房间编号。

collocations: raise an exception with a raise statement

words.enDefinition: allowing the exception currently being handled to continue propagating by raising it again

examples.en: The helper cleaned up its temporary data before reraising an exception for the caller to handle.
examples.zh: 辅助函数先清理临时数据，再「重新抛出异常」交由调用方处理。

examples.en: We discussed reraising an exception after recording which input row had caused the conversion to fail.
examples.zh: 我们记录了哪一行输入导致转换失败，接着讨论了「重新抛出异常」。

collocations: log an error before reraising an exception
finish cleanup before reraising an exception
keep the original traceback when reraising an exception

words.enDefinition: associating one exception with another through an explicit cause or an implicit handling context

examples.en: Python's exception chaining showed that the formatting failure came from an earlier error while converting the input.
examples.zh: Python 的「异常链」显示，格式化失败源于先前转换输入时的错误。

examples.en: We used exception chaining to retain the original cause while reporting the higher-level operation that failed.
examples.zh: 我们用「异常链」保留原始原因，同时报告失败的上层操作。

collocations: preserve a cause with exception chaining

words.enDefinition: an exception type defined by a program to represent a particular error condition of its own

examples.en: We defined a custom exception for a schedule that contained two conflicting bookings for the same room.
examples.zh: 我们为同一房间出现两个冲突预订的日程定义了「自定义异常」。

examples.en: The test handled the custom exception to check how the caller reported an invalid date range.
examples.zh: 测试处理了「自定义异常」，以检查调用方如何报告无效日期范围。

words.enDefinition: a Python object that manages entry to and exit from a with block, often to acquire and release resources

examples.en: The context manager closed the file when execution left the block that read the table.
examples.zh: 程序离开读取表格的语句块时，「上下文管理器」关闭了文件。

examples.en: We used a context manager to restore the previous display settings even if formatting failed during the example.
examples.zh: 我们用「上下文管理器」来恢复之前的显示设置，即使示例中格式化失败也能恢复。

words.enDefinition: a Python statement that executes a block under one or more context managers

examples.en: The with statement managed the active file while the program read the data for its chart.
examples.zh: 程序读取图表数据时，由「with 上下文语句」管理所打开的文件。

examples.en: We used a with statement to keep the temporary settings active only during the report's formatting.
examples.zh: 我们用「with 上下文语句」，让临时设置只在排版报告期间有效。

collocations: open a file in a with statement
execute the body of a with statement

words.enDefinition: a statement that checks a condition and signals a failed assertion when checks are enabled and the condition fails

examples.en: The assert statement checked that the list still contained the expected number of values after sorting.
examples.zh: 「assert 断言语句」检查排序后列表是否仍包含预期数量的值。

examples.en: We used an assert statement to document a condition that should hold after the helper returned.
examples.zh: 我们用「assert 断言语句」写明辅助函数返回后应当成立的条件。

collocations: check an invariant with an assert statement
disable execution of an assert statement

words.enDefinition: an event indicating that a condition checked by an assertion was not satisfied

examples.en: The assertion failure showed that the sorting exercise had removed an element when two names matched.
examples.zh: 「断言失败」表明排序练习在遇到两个相同的名字时删掉了一个元素。

examples.en: We reproduced the assertion failure with three rows so we could inspect each result in the notebook.
examples.zh: 我们用三行数据重现「断言失败」，这样就能在笔记本中逐一检查结果。
